text: Gorko goo, gomɗinɗo Allah, jeyaaɗo e yimɓe fir'awna ɓen, suuɗunooɗo yimɓe mun, gomɗinal makko ngal, saliiɗo fellitgol maɓɓe warugol Muusa ngol, o wi'i: E on waray gorko mo bonnaa, si wanaa fii o wi'i: Ko Allah woni Joomi am? Hara le o addanii on hujjaaji e ɓannganduyeeji, sembinayɗi goonga makko kan, wiide ko O nulaaɗo Joomi makko? Si tawii ko o fenuɗo, haray lorra fenaande makko nden, ko e makko yantata; si tawii non ko goonguɗo, haray yoga e ko o kammbirani on kon e lepte aduna ɗen, heɓay on. Pellet, Allah fewanataa e goonga, on tawɗo no yawti keeri Allah ɗin, fefindii fenaande, baki e Makko, Kanko e Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.
